title: Hearty Ethiopian Clams Bisque
description: A salty, gooey bisque that fuses Ethiopian berbere flavor with fresh clams and a rich fond, perfect for monsoon evenings.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and sauté the diced onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and berbere spice and fry for two minutes to release aromas.
Deglaze the pot with a splash of fish sauce, scraping up all browned bits from the bottom.
Pour in the vegetable stock and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the clams to the pot, cover, and cook for 5 minutes until the clams open, discarding any that remain closed.
Remove the pot from heat and stir in lemon juice and fresh parsley.
Season with black pepper, taste, and serve hot with crusty bread.
